_about: Everything this build made up, one line each, PROPOSED to Griz's ear (spec §8). Nothing here is written back to the wiki. Where the register holds a thing open, the game shows a visible [GRIZ] stub instead of inventing it.

entries.what: Barley's threshing flail statted as 1d10 bludgeoning, two-handed (so Great Weapon Fighting applies).
entries.why: No stats anywhere in the register; the register calls it 'a two-handed farm tool'.

entries.what: Barley starts with the flail and no armor (AC 11).
entries.why: The register has him owning nothing on Day -15; the game starts him at fighter 2 with his method in hand.

entries.what: The Warrens' 'Crawler' is an original stat block (AC 12, HP 40, feelers +5 1d6+2 poison with the register's CON DC 13 paralysis, mandibles +4 2d4+2).
entries.why: The carrion crawler is not in SRD 5.1; the spec forbids non-SRD monsters by name. The CON 13 touch is the register's own.

entries.what: The Stair's Keeper is an original stat block (AC 13, HP 58, constrict + drag under, STR DC 13 grapple, invisible in its water until light shows it).
entries.why: The water weird is not in SRD 5.1. The register's DC 13 and 'cannot leave its water' are kept.

entries.what: A 'Glory-Seeker' gnoll leader (CR 1, HP 38, spear + bite).
entries.why: The gnoll pack lord is not SRD; the register's Snoot overlay has glory-seekers.

entries.what: Hire terms: Barley joins if you front his 5-silver stake at the Hex; Aurdin if you cover his debt (20 sp, creditor unnamed — held OPEN); Vivian after you buy one of her candles (1 sp) and ask; Lymen once the party has any renown. Spots: Barley at the Hex bar, Lymen at the Hex, Aurdin outside the mission chapel, Vivian on vice row.
entries.why: The register gives no joining price for any of them; spots follow where the register places each.

entries.what: Hires join at the higher of their sheet level and (the lead's level - 1).
entries.why: Spec §13.7 suggestion (join-level floor).

entries.what: Level-up picks: Barley Champion at 3, STR+2 at 4; Aurdin Evocation, learns Scorching Ray + Mage Armor (3), Web + Shatter (4), Fireball + Lightning Bolt (5), INT+1/CON+1 at 4; Lymen Oath of Devotion at 3 (+Divine Favor), Heroism at 4, Lesser Restoration + Aid at 5, STR+1/CHA+1 at 4; Vivian DEX+2 at 4.
entries.why: SRD 5.1 offers one subclass per class; the register leaves Barley's and Lymen's unruled. Spells chosen from the SRD list for usefulness in menu combat (Griz 09-23: the build picks casters' spells; no need to include every spell).

entries.what: Vivian gets NO roguish archetype at level 3 (status shows '[GRIZ] archetype held open').
entries.why: The register holds it open (lean Assassin, not SRD) and says Thief is deliberately not taken.

entries.what: Lymen's AC is computed as 19 (chain mail 16 + shield 2 + Defense 1).
entries.why: His sheet reads 18 with Defense 'included' — the arithmetic doesn't reach 18. Flagged for Griz.

entries.what: Currency is silver pieces; SRD gp prices x10. Register prices win where they exist.
entries.why: The town talks in silver; the Hex stake, the dose-rate and the lantern law are all in silver.

entries.what: Calla's 'simples' heal 1d4+2 in the game.
entries.why: The register prices theriac/purges/simples at ~2 sp but gives no effect.

entries.what: A healer's kit is sold per use (5 sp) and gets a KO'd hero up at 1 HP.
entries.why: SRD kit (10 uses for 5 gp) stabilizes; the spec wants KO'd heroes revived 'with an item'.

entries.what: The tent is a consumable short-rest item (half HP back; Second Wind, Action Surge, Channel Divinity recover).
entries.why: Spec §7: short rest = a TENT item.

entries.what: Warding chalk pushes the next random encounter back ~60 steps.
entries.why: The register sells warding chalk and threshold lines with 'no promises made'; the effect is the game's.

entries.what: Lisbet's charm is a ring-slot item with no effect.
entries.why: 'Charms (no promises made)' — taken at its word.

entries.what: Vilar's show-armorer sells the full SRD weapon and armor list (beyond the register's spear, mace, shield); Kessler's pawn stocks a few pledges (rapier, crossbow, studded, splint, potion, two +1 weapons).
entries.why: The register has no armorer; Lymen's chain mail came from the show-armorer, so the game treats Vilar's as the armor shop.

entries.what: A night at the Halfway Inn costs 5 sp a head.
entries.why: No price in the register for ordinary guests.

entries.what: Encounter weights, group sizes and step rates for every zone.
entries.why: The register's road d20 and regional d8s name the creatures; the numbers are the game's.

entries.what: The Hex ladder for a free fighter: a floor-bet brawl (Bandit stats, fists), a freeman challenge vs a stable fighter (Thug), the card vs a hired blade (Bandit Captain stats), Talmok (register block, pit fists), then a festival bout (Berserker). Bouts are solo; a loser is stitched up on the house at 1 HP.
entries.why: The register has no ladder for free fighters; the rungs follow its stated rules.

entries.what: Using fire (spells, oil, torches) in a battle under a roosted ceiling breaks the one law: Sabeth stops paying and Ottilie won't speak to you.
entries.why: The register's one law; the mechanical consequence is the game's.

entries.what: Warrens flow: talk to Edric (or work a shift) to get in the book; talk to Skarn 'as a man' to open his gate; take the bucket to feed the otyugh or fight it; the mark wakes the keeper; rope the five out from the landing or wade in and fight. Killing 6+ crawlers makes the stock 'dead' and Dunmore's line holds the camp.
entries.why: Every step is the register's; the thresholds and the order are the game's.

entries.what: The rescue set-piece is fixed in G3's side gallery (four giant bats); pits in G3 drop to G4; bad air costs 1d4 on a failed CON 12.
entries.why: The register's set-piece is a d6 table fired once on the GM's word.

entries.what: Casting Light or using a torch in battle gives the cloaker disadvantage (its Light Sensitivity) and reveals the Keeper.
entries.why: SRD Light Sensitivity; the register says light is the weapon.

entries.what: The lake's offering plays the first night the party sleeps at the Halfway Inn holding the Ring of Binding; the chuul then waits at the point.
entries.why: Griz ruled what the cutscene shows (the inn lady and the kid go, only the inn lady comes back); when it plays is the game's.

entries.what: The Castegut road ends at a signpost (not this road, not this time); the east and west edges are the sea, the cliffs and the black mountains.
entries.why: Spec §5: east/west stoppages as appropriate.

entries.what: Ettercap fangs and the cloaker's tail are the proof tokens for Hessle's board.
entries.why: The register names the tail; the fangs are the game's.

entries.what: The lead starts in the Gate Plaza with 10 silver, 3 simples and 1 healer's kit.
entries.why: Barley's ten silver is canon; the rest is the game's.

entries.what: Each major quest (Pete's five, the rescue, the cloaker, the ettercap, Talmok, the Snoot) pays a magic weapon of the hero's own kind to the main and to one hired companion in the party: +1 for the first two, +2 after. Barley's is his threshing flail made +1/+2.
entries.why: Griz 09-23, mid-build: 'add magic weapons as reward for major quest - one for main and one for one hired'. The weapons are SRD Weapon +1/+2.

entries.what: Narration and UI lines marked 'invented: connective' in content/text.json and content/npcs.json.
entries.why: Glue between register facts.

entries.what: A Renown counter (+1 per resolved local job, +2 for the lake) and its titles; each point also gives 250 milestone XP to everyone standing.
entries.why: Spec §4: 'local hero' as the motive.

entries.what: All tile maps are simplified from corridor v3, city v6, environs v3 and the module sheets; building footprints, the Hex outline and the dungeon layouts are approximate.
entries.why: 8-bit tile scale.

griz_stubs: Ambrose Winters' own words (his particulars are reserved).
What is in Hessle's drawer when the cloaker's tail is weighed (the bounty's backer is held OPEN).
Aurdin's familiar (undecided until he does the ritual in story).
Vivian's roguish archetype (held open, lean Assassin).
The Halfway Inn's fate after the chuul (OPEN by ruling: 'do not ruin it').
flagged_for_griz: Lymen's sheet says AC 18; chain mail + shield + Defense makes 19.
fighter-barley.md records 'all three leads are level 2 at campaign start' (09-01) while the spec rules Aurdin's level 2 game-only (09-23).
Show-armorer: 'Villar' in shops-silverton.json, 'Vilar' elsewhere (the game uses Vilar).
Burned voice: the wiki gives it to Falstaff, silverton-personae.md to Merrick (the game gives it to Falstaff, per the wiki).
Kessler: the wiki's pronoun is 'her'; the portrait reads as a man. The game uses no pronoun.
